findings.title: Requests go round in a circle
findings.message: Decision service → Decision service: each waits for the next. A slow call holds all of them, and timeouts and retries multiply around the loop. Every thread can wait on the loop: deadlocked until a timeout breaks it.

fix.label: Make Decision service → Decision service a message

findings.title: Messages loop back
findings.message: Applications messages loop back to Decision service: each one is sent again.

agentReport.simulations: Played 1 saved simulation (at most 60 s each).
agentReport.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.
